children: SentinelOne completed a private offering of $1.25 billion of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, delivering net proceeds of about $1.408 billion. The notes, convertible at an initial price of approximately $31.21 per share (a 30% premium), mature on Oct 1, 2031 and may be settled in cash, stock, or both. Concurrently, SentinelOne entered into capped call transactions with a $48.02 initial cap to reduce potential dilution and offset cash payments above principal upon conversion. Proceeds also funded capped call costs and approximately $150 million of share repurchases, with the remainder for general corporate purposes.
